title: Full packing dimensional projections of measures
summary: We introduce a threshold parameter $D(μ)$ for a Borel probability measure $μ$ with compact support $E\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ such that, for every integer $1\leq m\leq n$, the orthogonal projection of $μ$ onto a typical $m$ dimensional subspace attains full packing dimension if and only if $m\leq D(μ)$.
